def VTask.bitCasesOn {motive : ℕ → Sort u} (n : ℕ) (bit : (b : Bool) → (n : ℕ) → motive (Nat.bit b n)) : motive n :=
  if h : n = 0 then
    -- Case: n = 0
    -- 0 = Nat.bit false 0
    have h₁ : motive (Nat.bit false 0) := bit false 0
    -- Since 0 = Nat.bit false 0, we can use the given 'bit' function to get the value of motive at 0
    have h₂ : motive 0 := by
      have h₃ : (Nat.bit false 0 : ℕ) = 0 := by
        norm_num [Nat.bit]
      -- Use the fact that Nat.bit false 0 = 0 to transfer the value of motive
      simpa [h₃] using h₁
    simpa [h] using h₂
  else
    -- Case: n ≠ 0
    -- Decompose n into its least significant bit and the remaining bits
    have h₁ : n ≠ 0 := h
    have h₂ : ∃ (b : Bool) (m : ℕ), n = Nat.bit b m := by
      use n.testBit 0, n >>> 1
      have h₃ : n = Nat.bit (n.testBit 0) (n >>> 1) := by
        have h₄ : n = 2 * (n >>> 1) + (n.testBit 0 ?= true : ℕ) := by
          have h₅ : n.testBit 0 = (n % 2 = 1) := by
            simp [Nat.testBit_zero, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
            <;> omega
          have h₆ : (n.testBit 0 ?= true : ℕ) = n % 2 := by
            split_ifs <;> simp_all [h₅] <;>
              (try omega) <;>
              (try
                {
                  have h₇ : n % 2 = 0 ∨ n % 2 = 1 := by omega
                  rcases h₇ with (h₇ | h₇) <;> simp_all [h₇] <;> omega
                })
          have h₇ : n = 2 * (n >>> 1) + (n % 2) := by
            have h₈ : n = 2 * (n / 2) + (n % 2) := by
              have h₉ := Nat.div_add_mod n 2
              omega
            have h₉ : n >>> 1 = n / 2 := by
              simp [Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
              <;>
              norm_num
            rw [h₉] at *
            exact h₈
          omega
        have h₅ : Nat.bit (n.testBit 0) (n >>> 1) = 2 * (n >>> 1) + (n.testBit 0 ?= true : ℕ) := by
          simp [Nat.bit]
          <;>
          split_ifs <;>
          simp_all [Nat.add_assoc] <;>
          norm_num <;>
          omega
        linarith
      exact h₃
    -- Obtain the bit and the remaining bits from the decomposition
    obtain ⟨b, m, h₃⟩ := h₂
    -- Use the given 'bit' function to get the value of motive at n
    have h₄ : motive (Nat.bit b m) := bit b m
    -- Since n = Nat.bit b m, we can use the fact to transfer the value of motive
    have h₅ : motive n := by
      have h₆ : (Nat.bit b m : ℕ) = n := by
        linarith
      simpa [h₆] using h₄
    exact h₅
